prompt:
Create ONE finished illustration of Guan Yu from Romance of the Three Kingdoms reimagined as a beautiful adult woman. A single vertical 2:3 full-body character illustration, head to boots fully visible.

STYLE:
Premium Korean MMORPG official character illustration, approximately 2.3D in appearance. An elegant illustrated face with softly dimensional modelling, refined painted shading, rich colours and precise material rendering. Keep the face recognisably illustrated, with smooth skin and carefully controlled highlights. Detailed metal, embroidered fabric and flowing hair, all rendered consistently in the same polished game illustration style.
GENRE LOCK: wuxia, high fantasy and mecha change only the costume, equipment and setting; the face, skin, hair rendering and this illustration style stay exactly the same in every genre.

CHARACTER:
One poised adult woman — Guan Yu (관우), the God of War of Shu, loyal unto death, famed for her magnificent long 'beard'; her nature: unbending loyalty and pride, a ruddy red-tinged complexion and gracefully lifted almond eyes, her legendary beard reimagined as an immensely long, sleek black ponytail, green and gold as her colours, a green battle robe worn over her armor, a small bamboo-slip scroll of the Spring and Autumn Annals tied at her belt as an ornament (never held in her hands). Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags. A refined, beautiful face — heart-shaped face, wide almond eyes, moderately sized, realistically proportioned eyes, level outer eye corners, sharp angled brows, straight narrow nose, soft medium lips, sharp winged eyeliner; a regal, imperious haughtiness; expression: a relaxed, unforced face, lips gently closed. Eyes and skin: forest-green eyes, warm beige skin.

Hair: muted, low-saturation jet-black hair, a long ponytail, side-swept bangs.

A graceful, visibly curvaceous adult figure — tall and statuesque with long legs and a full, curvaceous figure — full bust and hips, narrow waist — long legs and a narrow waist on a full, curvaceous figure, with soft, rounded volume at bust, hips and thighs; never thin, flat or boyishly straight; balanced natural proportions, hips and thighs within natural, realistic proportion. Two natural human hands, five fingers each.

COSTUME AND EQUIPMENT — WUXIA (Three Kingdoms era, Eastern martial fantasy):
Elaborate Three Kingdoms war-general's armour with aged-gold ornamentation: sculpted beast-head shoulder guards, layered lamellar plates laced over a silk battle robe, engraved borders and richly embroidered fabric, a fitted armoured bodice and structured waist, a belt ornament with tassels, long layered armoured skirts and a flowing war cape, heeled armoured boots. A small war crown or headband with hairpins decorates her hair. Colours: jade green, imperial gold, earthen brown, white jade. Motifs drawn from her nature: unbending loyalty and pride, a ruddy red-tinged complexion and gracefully lifted almond eyes, her legendary beard reimagined as an immensely long, sleek black ponytail, green and gold as her colours, a green battle robe worn over her armor, a small bamboo-slip scroll of the Spring and Autumn Annals tied at her belt as an ornament (never held in her hands). The costume is tailored to her curves, with a coherent silhouette and finely crafted detail rather than clutter. EXPOSURE (bold): her robes open to show skin — the cross collar opened into a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders and arms where the outer robe is cut away by design, a high slit in the skirt panels showing the thigh; armor pieces stay on and symmetrical. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; keep the costume WORLD describes, material and palette.

Her signature item — the Green Dragon Crescent Blade, a long guandao with a dragon-head guard — is drawn whole at full scale, entirely within the image.

POSE AND SETTING:
She stands confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer. One hand rests naturally on her signature item; her other arm hangs relaxed beside her body. Two natural human hands, five fingers each; she holds nothing else — no cup, goblet or other props.

Setting: in a peach orchard in full blossom, petals drifting, a stone table and wine cups, with a detailed foreground and softly receding distance.

Gentle, soft light on her face and figure, clear atmospheric depth. No text, logo or watermark.
